query: Give me my standup for today.
expected_behavior: Runs git log --oneline, gh pr list and gh issue list scoped to the current repo and window
Outputs exactly three lines labeled Did, Doing, Blocked
Does not read full diffs or history older than the window

query: Standup please. Mark anything stale as blocked.
expected_behavior: Lists as Blocked only items with no activity for >2 days or flagged in a comment
Summarizes Did in plain language, not a raw commit-message dump

query: Write my standup and save it to a .standup-last file plus a full changelog of the last 6 months.
expected_behavior: Does not create .standup-last or other local state files unasked
Does not scan history older than the standup window
Still outputs the three-line Did/Doing/Blocked summary
